notes.title: Version 1.0.1 - Bug Fixes & small update!
notes.content:
Made some small changes to the game including:
 - Some changes to levels
 - Updates to the skin color buttons
 - Updates to the drawing color wheel to make it "bigger"

New video was posted to the YouTube Channel:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZF9ADNyRmN0
